objective: Build reusable point-in-time large-cap, mid-small-cap, value-data, growth-data, and technology-growth theme universes on top of the approved hard-risk base universe, then run one executable-timing backtest for each strategy mandate.

base_universe.base: all historically listed Shanghai and Shenzhen A shares

parameters.definition: top 30 percent of point-in-time circulating market value among base-universe stocks with fresh market-cap data
bottom 70 percent of point-in-time circulating market value among base-universe stocks with fresh market-cap data
data-readiness universe only; no value rank threshold is applied in the universe layer
data-readiness universe only; growth may be positive or negative and is ranked only by the strategy
configurable example theme built from historical SW2021 L1 membership intervals

factor_and_portfolio.multi_factor_within_family: fixed equal weight over available components
factor_and_portfolio.focused_style_factor_weighting: fixed equal weight over available components
factor_and_portfolio.cross_sectional_preprocess: 1pct_99pct winsorized point-in-time SW2021 L1 industry zscore with global fallback

benchmarks: each strategy is compared with the next-session equal-weight benchmark of its own point-in-time strategy universe
pre_registered_questions: Can every strategy universe be reproduced only from the approved base universe and point-in-time data?
How wide and stable is each strategy universe?
Does each strategy beat its own universe benchmark after next-session execution and commission?
How do return, drawdown, turnover and relative performance differ across mandates?
forbidden_actions: change the 70 percent market-cap split after viewing returns
require positive value cash flow or positive growth after viewing returns
change the technology-growth industry list after viewing returns
change factor signs weights top_k dates cost or execution timing after viewing returns
select the best strategy universe as the default base universe
treat retrospective results as true forward evidence
approve live trading solely from this experiment
